shape.law: one question, two answers, nothing else — no sub-menus, no second-stage 'really sure', no timer, no cost preview beyond the question itself
shape.onNo: cancels the input whole — no item consumed, no turn spent, no deed, no record of the asking; hesitation is not a deed and the ledger never learns a prompt was refused
shape.onYes: the act runs exactly as its own system specifies it
shape.strings: prompt copy lives in #23's string layer as display data, one string id per class
